test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The list price of a washing machine is ₹13,200. It is sold to a retailer after a 20% discount. What is the cost price of the washing machine to the retailer?
solution:
**Given:**

List price of the washing machine = ₹13,200

Discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost price after discount = List price × (1 - Discount percentage)

**Calculation:**

Discount percentage = 20% = 20/100 = 0.2

Cost price after discount = ₹13,200 × (1 - 0.2)

⇒ Cost price after discount = ₹13,200 × 0.8

⇒ Cost price after discount = ₹10,560

**The cost price of the washing machine to the retailer is ₹10,560.**
